baseline.split_rule: Sorted day IDs assigned round-robin to folds. Every day is held out once; no reports from a test day enter its training counts.
baseline.backoff_rule: Unseen L1 -> L0; unseen L2 -> L1; L3 interpolates cell counts with k times its L2 probabilities, including zero cells. L4 interpolates path-cue counts with k times L3; missing values have explicit bins. Single-cue and no-path control losses are diagnostics, not model-selection results.
baseline.units: Natural-log multiclass log loss, mean and population standard deviation across day folds; all-reports and headline scopes are separate.
